name: The Apostolic Fathers
translation: Selected excerpts adapted from the Ante-Nicene Fathers translation (1885)
note: The earliest Christian writings outside the New Testament: the Didache, a church manual from the first century; the Shepherd of Hermas, the most widely read Christian book of the second century; and the letter of Clement of Rome, written while some apostles were likely still alive.

books.name: The Didache — The Teaching of the Twelve
